about: The public functions of llm-memory-calculator/src, BudSimulator/src, BudSimulator/apis and bud_component.py that read a model-shape key (kv_corpus.SHAPE_KEYS) -- in their own body or through a private helper -- but that the corpus harness (scripts/kv_corpus.py) does not call itself. An entry with a reason is no memory or capacity figure of a model config (a FLOP, time or communication estimate, a benchmark record, a constructor, a database write, a network-bound route, code nothing calls); an entry marked helper returns its figure only to the functions it names in used_by, each measured, excluded or such a helper. tests/test_kv_gate.py fails on any public reader neither called by the harness nor named here, on a helper some unheld function uses or whose used_by is stale, and on an entry that names no public reader, gives no reason, or that the harness calls.

entries.reason: the gated-model submission route: it fetches HF Hub metadata, scrapes the model page and calls BudLLM over the network, which the harness does not do. Its one figure is the calculator's parameter count (ModelMemoryCalculator.calculate_model_weights), the same call /models/add/config and the model manager make, both measured (route_add_params, route_manager_params)
the database command line: it prints the rows the database holds, whose parameter count is the one sync_static_models_to_db stores (measured, loader_sync_params)

imports a model from the HuggingFace Hub over the network (its config, card and logo) into the database: network-bound, as the submission route is; the config it stores is read back through the model manager, measured (route_manager_params, the routes)
writes the config and the figures it is handed to the database; it sizes nothing (what the callers hand it is measured where they compute it: loader_sync_params, route_add_params)
writes the config and the figures it is handed to the database; it sizes nothing

ranks hardware for a memory figure the caller hands it (required_memory_gb) and a time estimate from the config's num_parameters; nothing in the repository calls it (the use-case route's own recommendations are measured, route_usecase)

groups a queue of requests into one batch for budevolve's CPU scheduling search (the hidden width sizes its L3 check); it returns the batch, no memory or capacity figure of a model config, and nothing in the repository calls it
the engine's start-up time (loading the weights, capturing CUDA graphs); a time estimate, not memory or capacity -- the weights it loads are facts_weight_bytes, measured
a FLOP count of a training step or layer, not memory or capacity; it takes the shape as arguments and holds no KV, state or weight figure

a self-check of the kernel-launch overhead estimate on fixed layer counts; it reports pass / fail on timings, reads no model config
registers a ModelConfig in the collection under its name; it returns nothing and sizes nothing

the constructor: it stores the fields it is handed and derives the per-layer placement (layer_type); every figure is read off the object by the readers the harness measures (get_kv_size, get_request_fixed_bytes, the graphs, model_parameter_count through the serving path and the loader)

ZeRO++'s communication time for a training step, from the parameter count it is given; a time or communication-rate estimate, not memory or capacity

the share of MoE tokens routed to an expert on the same device (a communication rate for the all-to-all time), from the expert count and expert-parallel degree it is given; a time or communication-rate estimate, not memory or capacity
an abstract method (its body is `pass`): a feature that implements it is its own figure path

the optimizer update as a roofline operator (the parameters it is handed, its FLOPs and the bytes it streams a step): an operator's traffic, not memory held -- the optimizer state a model holds is calculate_optimizer_memory's, measured (optmem_gb)
the bytes the optimizer update operator reads and writes in one step (its roofline traffic), not memory held; the optimizer state is calculate_optimizer_memory's, measured (optmem_gb)
the backward pass's time from the forward pass's operators; a time or communication-rate estimate, not memory or capacity

builds the backward embedding operator's FLOP and byte row for a training graph from the shape it is given; nothing in the repository calls it, and its bytes are an operator's traffic, not memory held
a FLOP count of a training step or layer, not memory or capacity; it takes the shape as arguments and holds no KV, state or weight figure
the optimizer update's roofline row (FLOPs, bytes streamed, latency, boundedness) for a parameter count it is given; a time and traffic estimate, not memory or capacity
a command-line entry point that profiles kernels on a live device and writes the records the perf store reads; no figure of a model config

reads no model config: it renders the kv_plan's dtype for an engine that lists kv_fp8, and 'sliding_window' is the vLLM argument value it emits when the plan's skip flag is set. The fp8 KV decision on a model is kv.dtype.kv_fp8_support and the planner's KVDtypeV2, both measured (kvfp8_bytes, plan_kv_bytes)

a fixed router-overhead efficiency factor by expert count, a compute factor, not memory or capacity
the share of an MoE model's parameters a token runs through (a compute ratio); its memory figure, memory_multiplier, is measured (amc_kv[2])
the pipeline's activation-passing delay as a fraction of step time; a time or communication-rate estimate, not memory or capacity; nothing in the repository calls it
